objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use aria2's open JSON-RPC interface to write a file that gives you command execution, then read /ctf/flag.
hints: aria2 1.18.8 exposes JSON-RPC on port 6800 with no secret token; read the aria2 manual for aria2.addUri and its dir and out options.
Think about which files on a Linux system get executed automatically once written. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the product
steps.prompt: Which version of aria2 does the server run? (number only)

steps.title: Find the method
steps.prompt: Which RPC method downloads a URL to a path of your choice? (method name)

steps.title: Find the option
steps.prompt: Which option of that method chooses the target directory? (option name)
